summary: The normal-graph tangential-derivative and Jacobian theorems are stated only for `HasFDerivAt` with `s ∈ 𝓝 x`, but their proofs only use the within-set, density-one hypotheses; three `*_eq_of_unique` lemmas also repeat the same proof instead of deriving from one general lemma.
